name: video-creation-workspace
description: 视频创作：DesireCore 视频创作应用，复用 OpenFilm 的文件格式、Studio 编辑器和渲染内核。

scripts.dev: pnpm build && node desirecore/cli.mjs start --home .dev/video-creation --project examples/first-film
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 desirecore/runtime.test.mjs desirecore/service.integration.test.mjs desirecore/release.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @desirecore-agent/video-creation test:smoke
